crossRefs.note: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know…
A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are…
He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know…

parallels.note: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it.”

translations.web: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
translations.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
translations.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
translations.asv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
